Most affordable 24GB 15-inch M5 MacBook Air is $200 off today, more

The AirPods Pro 3 deals are rolling this summer and we even have $500 off M5 Pro MacBook Pro, but the M5 MacBook Air deals have been hard to come by over the last month or so. We are starting to see Amazon delivering $100 off the new lists to offer some price increase relief, but we also just spotted a notable $200 price drop on this 24GB model Amazon doesn’t carry over at B&H.

Amazon is offering $100 off a number of both 13- and 15-inch M5 MacBook Air configurations right now:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,199 (Now Reg. $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,499 (Now Reg. $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,699 (Now Reg. $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,399 (Now Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,699 (Now Reg. $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,899 (Now Reg. $1,999)

As you’ll notice above, Amazon does not carry the official 24GB/1TB 15-inch M5 MacBook Air configuration – the most affordable 24GB model you can buy. The authorized Apple dealers over at B&H do, however, and it is now offering it at $200 off the list price:

B&H is offering the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB of RAM and the 512GB storage capacity down at $1,499 shipped. This is now a regularly $1,699 machine and is now $200 off the list price.

You’re looking one of the best M5 MacBook Air deals we have tracked since official price increases hit retail.

If it’s the MacBook Pro you’re after, we have configs at $400 and $500 off the list prices this week, and not just the super high-end models:

Land an M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB at $500 off, 48GB model at $400 off, more

Alongside ongoing Black Friday in July pricing on AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off and $100 off all colors of Apple’s AirPods Max 2, we are also still seeing some serious price increase relief on the latest M5 MacBook Pro lineup. Some of the real highlights here are the 24GB/2TB M5 Pro 14-inch model at $500 off the list price courtesy of Amazon and this 48GB model at $400 off over at B&H.

Quite literally the best M5 Pro MacBook Pro deal we have tracked since the price hikes went live, Amazon is offering the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro down at $2,499 shipped. Regularly $2,999, this is the model with 24GB of RAM and the 2TB internal storage capacity down at $500 off the new list price.

This deal is particularly good considering Apple just raised the price on this configuration by $400 and even before that happened it had never dropped below $2,340 at Amazon.

Another highlight of this week’s MacBook Pro deals is B&H’s offer on the 48GB/1TB 14-inch M5 Pro model down at $2,799 shipped. You’re certainly paying more here for double the RAM, but this is also $400 off the $3,199 list price and a configuration you can’t even buy at Amazon.

The rest of the MacBook Pro deals we are tracking to kick the week await below:

Amazon’s best quality renewed iPhone 17 Pro units are $220 off, 17 Pro Max up to $450 off

If you’re liking to secure yourself a current-generation iPhone 17 Pro or Pro Max at a discount, there are some options floating around this week. Deals on brand new unlocked condition units are tough to come by from reputable sources, but we are still tracking up to $220 off 17 Pro in Amazon’s best quality renewed condition, and Woot is once again highlighting the up to $450 off 17 Pro Max right now.

Over at Amazon you’ll find the 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models live again at up to $220 off – these are Amazon Renewed Premium units with a 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and “greater than 90% original battery life.” Standard Amazon refurbished units only come with a 90-day warranty and you don’t get the same battery guarantee either.

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)

  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,199 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,199 (Reg. $1,299 new)

Over at Woot, however, the larger 17 Pro Max deals are still flying on “pristine” condition units that “have never been in customer hands.” You’re looking at up to $450 off the list prices from Apple here but color options are starting to dwindle:

  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 512GB $1,300 (Reg. $1,399)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 1TB $1,450 (Reg. $1,599)

Apple Watch Series 11 summer deals starting to disappear, get in there while most popular models are still $100 off

While we are still tracking summer sale pricing on AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off, AirPods Max 2 at $100 off, and all-time low pricing on the 4-pack of Apple’s AirTag 2, but the deals on the most affordable Apple Watch Series 11 are starting to disappear. You’ll want to get in there as soon as possible if you’re interested in upgrading your Apple wearable at $100 off.

Amazon is currently offering the 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 down at $299 and the 46mm model at $329 shipped. That’s $100 off the respective $399 and $429 regular list prices on the most affordable models you can buy.

However, color options on these deals are starting to disappear now. There are still a few colors live at the discounted rates, but it appears these summertime discounts on the Series 11 are starting to either go out of stock or jump back up as of this week.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (Reg. $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (Reg. $429)

AirPods 4 with ANC down as low as $119 at Amazon right now, more from $99

The summer sale and Black Friday in July deals on the current-generation AirPods lineup are rolling on into this week. We are still tracking AirPods Pro 3 down at $50 off the list price while AirPods Max 2 in all colors are $100 off. However, we are still tracking the best price in several months on AirPods 4 with ANC and Amazon Renewed Premium units as low as $119.

Amazon is offering Apple’s AirPods 4 with ANC at $144.99 shipped. Regularly $179, this is 20% off the list price and the best deal we have seen since March.

Just keep in mind that you can land the Amazon Renewed Premium set down at $119 right now as well – this is an Amazon Renewed Premium unit with a 1-year guarantee to deliver the best renewed quality Amazon offers.

For some, unless you’re specially looking to score the AirPods 4 form-factor, spending the extra $55 to land a pair of AirPods Pro 3 while they are on sale is a better option than these deals, but we are nonetheless tracking notable price drops across the board here on whichever set you’re after.
